questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to cook macaroni and cheese
World records for eating biscuits
Comfort food and why we want to eat it
Why Italian food is the healthiest
questions.why: Rob says they'll discuss comfort food and what actually makes us eat it.

questions.q: Why does Rob like eating biscuits?
options: They are quick, easy and make him feel good
They are healthy
His doctor recommends them
They help him concentrate at work
questions.why: Rob says they're a quick and easy sweet treat and they make him feel good.

questions.q: What makes foods like biscuits, crisps and pizza easy comfort foods, according to Neil?
options: They are cheap to buy in any shop
They are easy and need no cooking skills
They last a long time
They are low in sugar
questions.why: Neil says they're easy to snack on and don't require many culinary skills.

questions.q: According to Shira Gabriel, why does macaroni and cheese comfort her?
options: It is her favourite meal at an expensive restaurant
It is quick and easy to make when she is tired after work
It is the healthiest food she knows and has lots of vitamins
It reminds her of being cared for by people who loved her
questions.why: She says those foods were made for her by people who loved and took care of her.

questions.q: What happens when Shira eats these foods?
options: She feels guilty about eating unhealthy food
She feels hungry again quickly
She gets a rush of good feelings
She forgets her memories
questions.why: She says eating them gives her a rush of positive feelings and a sense of acceptance.

questions.q: Why can eating comfort food be complicated, according to Neil?
options: It is always more expensive than healthy food
Food high in sugar or salt can make us feel guilty
It makes us forget our happy childhood memories
It is hard to find in shops and supermarkets
questions.why: Neil says food high in carbohydrates, sugar or salt can make us feel guilty.

questions.q: What did Jenny Linford learn from her Italian friends?
options: They eat comfort food every single day
They think comfort food is unhealthy
They only eat pasta when they are sad
To them, all food is comfort
questions.why: They said 'food is always comfort and always pleasure', so they don't have the phrase.

questions.q: What does Jenny Linford conclude about the idea of comfort food?
options: It is not universal and differs between cultures
It is the same everywhere in the world
It was invented in Italy
It is only for children
questions.why: She says the idea of comfort food 'is not universal, it's actually quite nuanced'.
